title: Check and Collect
setup: The black king is tucked on h8 and the rook sits on d8, both one knight leap from the same square.
hint: Find the square from which your knight touches the king and the rook on the same move.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nf7+}} attacks h8 and d8 at once. The check is not optional: nothing can capture on f7, and a knight check can never be blocked, so {{Kg8}} is Black's only legal move. Then {{Nxd8}} collects the rook.
